title: Backflow test records: retain the evidence that closes the obligation
description: A complete test record ties the property and assembly to the official requirement, tester, date, result, any repair or retest, and submission confirmation.
prompt: Which documents prove that an asset is actually closed out?
answer: A complete test record ties the property and assembly to the official requirement, tester, date, result, any repair or retest, and submission confirmation. A single invoice or verbal assurance is not the compliance record.
urgency: Escalate missing report fields, unclear asset match, a failed result without retest evidence, or no filing confirmation.
diagramAlt: Backflow service and compliance workflow reference
identifiers: Keep asset identity and notice or program requirement with the report.
